components.name: FRVP
components.description: Fixed Range Volume Profile drawing — renders horizontal volume bars anchored to a time/price range on the chart. Two modes: anchor (single time point + manual price range) and range (two time points + auto price range from candles).
dependencies: useChartBars (live volume map accumulation from trade ticks)
DrawingsPrimitive (pane view registration, preview renderers, hover price relay)
notes: rightEdge = t2BitmapX ?? (anchorX + maxBarW) — key formula for all placement/POC logic; t2BitmapX is null in anchor mode
Three bar-drawing modes inside _drawBars: price (rowSizeMode='price' + rowSizePrice), count (numBars buckets), raw (one bar per tick level when numBars=0)
Volume map is a live Map<price, volume> accumulated from trade ticks in useChartBars; range mode filters it via computeRangeBounds()
Preview renderers (FRVPPreviewRenderer, FRVPRangePreviewRenderer) only draw dashed lines — no bar rendering, no placement logic needed
STORE_VERSION is auto-bumped by pre-commit hook (.git/hooks/pre-commit) whenever any file in frontend/src/store/ is staged — never bump manually
barPlacement ('left'|'right'|'middle') and barOffset (CSS px gap) are style settings; 'middle' starts bars at centerX and grows right — not mirrored
barLength (1–100%) scales maxBarW before _drawBars — controls max bar width as % of rectangle width; applied after range-mode capping
extendPoc=true spans the POC line across the full rectangle (anchorX → rightEdge) regardless of placement or offset
volumeType field is reserved for future delta/up-down volume; only 'total' is wired up — greyed out in UI
Expand animation uses _expandMap (price → current expand px) with EXPAND_LERP=0.25 lerp per frame; _requestUpdate triggers redraws

components.name: MarketDepthSettingsModal
components.description: Settings modal for the Market Depth indicator. Two tabs: Input (Row Layout dropdown + Row Size spinner) and Style (Color swatch, Hover Expand toggle, Placement dropdown, Offset spinner, Length % spinner). Follows the same pattern as FRVPSettingsPopover — uses Popover shell with persistKey.
dependencies: layoutSlice (domRowLayout, domRowSize, domBarPlacement, domBarOffset, domBarLength + second* variants)
notes: Row Layout: 'count' (N rows over price range) or 'price' (N ticks per row). Default 'price'/1 = original 1-tick-per-row behavior.
barLength (1–100) maps to % of chart width; default 30 matches old MAX_WIDTH_RATIO=0.30 hardcode.
Bucketing is done at render time in _buildBars — _volumeMap stays tick-level so FRVP can still read getVolumeMap().
Placement 'left'=bars from left+offset; 'right'=bars from right-offset growing left; 'middle'=bars from center+offset.
persistKey='popover-market-depth' so position survives re-opens.
Pencil button in IndicatorsDropdown closes the dropdown and opens this modal; cancel button reverts all settings via snapshot.

components.name: DrawingEditToolbar
components.description: Floating toolbar that appears when a drawing is selected. Shows type-specific controls: color, fill color, text, stroke width/style, hline extend/template, rect settings, FRVP input/style tabs. Multi-select shows count + delete only.
dependencies: FRVPToolbarPanel (FRVP-specific tab panel, lives in FRVP component)
useDraggable (drag logic with optional bounds clamping)
notes: closeAll() resets every popover state — always call it before opening a new one
FRVP branch renders FRVPToolbarPanel (just a settings button); settings live in FRVPSettingsPopover modal
lineStyleDefs.ts is shared between StrokePopover and RectSettingsPopover — edit there, not inline
TextColorGrid was removed (was dead code — never rendered)
Draggable via useDraggable; bounds=containerRef keeps toolbar clamped inside chart container (incl. scale) — drag cannot exit chart area
initialPos prefers container-relative top-left; saved position re-clamped to container bounds on open

components.name: ColorPopover
components.description: Color picker popover with palette, custom colors, opacity slider. ColorSwatchButton renders a fixed portal anchored to the swatch button. Used by all drawing style controls.
notes: ColorSwatchButton computes portal position synchronously in onClick (not useEffect) to avoid stale position on first open
Position clamped: left = Math.min(r.left, window.innerWidth - 290 - 8) so picker never overflows right edge
mousemove listener active while open to reposition when parent modal is dragged (useDraggable)
useClickOutside uses capture phase (addEventListener 3rd arg = true) so modal stopPropagation doesn't block it

components.name: Dropdown
components.description: Shared dropdown panel shell. Handles absolute positioning + standard styling (surface bg, border, SHADOW.LG, rounded-lg, Z.DROPDOWN). Caller owns open state, wrapper ref, and useClickOutside. For option-list dropdowns use CustomSelect; for action rows use MenuItem inside Dropdown.
notes: Props: align ('left'|'right', default 'left'), offset (px gap, default 4), minWidth, className, style
Caller must wrap trigger + Dropdown in a `position: relative` div and call useClickOutside on that wrapper ref
Item hover: hover:bg-(--color-hover-row); active/selected: bg var(--color-text), color var(--color-surface)
Toolbar buttons use hover:bg-(--color-border) — different from dropdown items, intentional
Camera screenshot dropdown (ChartToolbar) is intentionally different: uses inline div with rounded-xl + SHADOW.XXL + --color-panel bg — pass overrides via style/className when needed
CustomSelect manages its own fixed positioning and panel styling; don't wrap it in Dropdown
CustomSelect supports renderItemAction, renderItem, footer, dropdownMinWidth — used by Strategy Lab strategy dropdown

components.name: Popover
components.description: Shared draggable modal popover shell. Handles drag (useDraggable), click-outside close (useClickOutside), stop propagation, fixed centered positioning, header with title + X button, and footer with Cancel/Ok buttons. Used by all settings modals.
notes: onCancel prop — cancel button handler; falls back to onClose if not provided
children render between the two hr dividers (after header, before footer) — bring your own body padding
onMouseDown stopPropagation on root div is required for drag to work without collapsing the popover
LockoutButton previously used Popover as a dropdown shell — now inlines its own div; Popover is modal-only

components.name: ChartSettingsModal
components.description: Full-screen settings modal for chart configuration. Sidebar with 4 categories (Bars, Canvas, Trading, Events). Inline drag logic (not useDraggable) with grab/grabbing cursor. Cancel snapshots settings on open and reverts on cancel. Escape key triggers cancel.
notes: Uses inline drag (dragging ref + dragOffset ref) instead of useDraggable — sets document.body.style.cursor grabbing on mousedown, clears on mouseup
snapshotRef captures settings on mount; handleCancel restores snapshot then closes
Category sidebar: 'bars' | 'canvas' | 'trading' | 'events'

components.name: SpinnerInput
components.description: Compact numeric input with hover-reveal up/down chevron arrows. Supports click (±step) and click-hold-drag (scrub up/down at 2px/step). Used across all style toolbars.
notes: Drag activates only after DRAG_THRESHOLD (3px) movement — quick clicks are never treated as drags
didDragRef suppresses onClick on the arrow buttons after a real drag to prevent double-step at release
ns-resize cursor and userSelect:none applied to document.body only while dragging; cleaned up on mouseup
valueRef tracks current value for drag start capture; avoids stale closure in mousemove handler

components.name: StrategyLab
components.description: Full-screen backtesting workspace. Accessible via Strategy button in ChartToolbar. Shows a full CandlestickChart fed from extracted tick CSVs, a script editor, an equity curve (EquityCurveChart — LWC-based, shared with the stats dashboard), stats row, and trade log (BacktestTradesTable). Symbols categorized by exchange/symbol.
dependencies: backtestSlice (open/close, exchange, symbol, dateRange, timeframe, strategyCode, running, result)
backtestService (getSymbols, getBars, getAvailableRange, runStrategy SSE client)
backtestRoutes (GET /backtest/symbols, GET /backtest/bars, GET /backtest/range, POST /backtest/run, GET/PUT/PATCH/DELETE /backtest/strategies/:name, GET/PUT /backtest/strategies/:name/result)
notes: Data layout: backend/data/tick-data/{EXCHANGE}/{SYMBOL}/{YYYY}/{MM}.csv (+ {MM}.1m.json cache) — run 'npm run extract-ticks' in backend to populate
Extract script: backend/src/scripts/extractTickData.ts — reads Binance ZIPs/CSVs from TICK_DATA_PATH env var, extracts to tick-data dir
Cache dir: backend/data/backtest-cache/ — JSON files keyed by exchange_symbol_tf_fromDay_toDay.json
Strategy execution: vm.runInNewContext sandbox, onBar(ctx) called per bar, ctx.buy/sell/close/setStop/setTarget
SSE streaming: POST /backtest/run streams equity points as they build, then sends done event
CONTRACT_MAP in StrategyLabModal.tsx maps 'EXCHANGE:SYMBOL' → Contract; fallback uses generic 0.01 tick defaults
GET /backtest/symbols scans tick-data dir and returns available exchange/symbol pairs
backtestExchange + backtestSymbol in backtestSlice — selector dropdown in modal header
chartId='backtest' extends 'left'|'right'|'backtest' type — guard in setSelectedChart and drillIntoCandle
File persistence: strategies saved to backend/data/strategies/{name}/strategy.js; last result to result.json in same folder
On modal open: listStrategies() from disk seeds the store; empty disk → current store strategies seeded to disk
Strategy code auto-saves 800ms after last keystroke; result saves after each successful run
On strategy switch: equity chart clears immediately, then loadResult() from disk restores chart + stats via setData()

Vertical resize: chart vs results split is controlled by backtestBottomRatio (persisted, 0..0.85, default 0.3). VerticalSeparator drives drag; toggleBacktestBottom collapses/restores via backtestBottomPreviousRatio — mirrors App.tsx pattern

Bottom panel content fills via flex: stats + tabs are shrink-0; equity curve receives height='100%' (LWC autoSize handles repaint); trades table receives maxHeight='100%' (SortableTable virtualization re-measures via ResizeObserver)

Bars cache (backtestService.ts): LRU Map keyed by exchange:symbol:unit:unitNumber:from:to, MAX_BARS_CACHE=20. streamBars checks cache first and delivers the full array as one synthetic chunk via microtask; on miss it accumulates streamed chunks and writes to cache on the SSE 'done' event. Aborts mid-stream do not populate the cache

Windowed render (useChartBars backtest effect): only the most recent VIEWPORT_BARS=500 bars go to LWC initially; scrolling within 50 logical bars of the left edge expands the window backward by EXPAND_BARS=1000. refs.bars / refs.dataMap / refs.lastBar always hold the full array so drawings, FRVP and crosshair are unaffected by the window. Window expansion preserves the visible time range (getVisibleRange → setData → setVisibleRange) since logical indices shift

Streaming UX: chunks are accumulated silently and rendered once at end (avoids O(N²) setData on long streams). First load of an (exchange, symbol, range, tf) shows the chart only after streaming completes; subsequent timeframe switches with the same symbol+range are instant from cache

components.name: OHLCTooltip
components.description: Inline OHLC tooltip rendered in the chart's top-left overlay. Shows O/H/L/C values and change for the hovered candle (falls back to last bar). Labels (O H L C) use --color-text; values use --color-text-medium (bullish) or teal (#0097a6) (bearish). DOM built once with pre-created spans for perf — no innerHTML per frame.
notes: Label color (O H L C) = COLOR_TEXT = var(--color-text), matching symbol/timeframe text in the same overlay row
Value color switches only when bullish/bearish direction changes — avoids per-frame style recalc
Spans are created once in useEffect; effect reruns on contract/timeframe change (new decimal precision needed)

components.name: TimeframePicker
components.description: Shared timeframe selector used by both ChartToolbar and StrategyLabModal. Renders pinned shortcut buttons + chevron trigger + grouped dropdown (Seconds/Minutes/Hours/Days). Pinning, custom timeframes, and trash buttons are all optional — omit those props for a simple picker.
notes: pinnedTimeframes + onPin + onUnpin all required together to enable pinning — omit all three for simple mode (StrategyLabModal)
onAddCustom + onRemoveCustom both required together to show custom input section
StarIcon is exported — reused by InstrumentSelectorPopover and similar components
Trigger button style differs: no border/bg when hasPinning (ChartToolbar inline style), bordered when standalone (StrategyLabModal)

components.name: SymbolPickerModal
components.description: Shared symbol search modal. Same visual as InstrumentSelectorPopover (header, search input, item list). Accepts generic SymbolItem[] so any data source can use it. Currently used by StrategyLabModal for backtest symbol selection.
notes: SymbolItem: { key, name, exchange, description? } — key must be unique, used for selectedKey comparison
Client-side search filters by name and exchange
Active item highlighted with --color-warning text (matches InstrumentSelectorPopover active style)
InstrumentSelectorPopover has its own complex implementation (live search, bookmarks, categories) — SymbolPickerModal is for simpler static lists

components.name: DatePickerModal
components.description: Shared calendar modal used by both GoToModal (single date + time) and DateRangePicker (from/to range). Handles modal shell, month nav, and calendar grid. mode='single' shows date/time inputs + today highlight + Cancel/Confirm footer. mode='range' shows From/To selector buttons + range highlight + Done footer.
notes: mode='single': pass today prop for timezone-aware today highlight (defaults to UTC today); GoToModal passes nyNow()
mode='single': time input is optional — omit time/onTimeChange props to hide it
mode='range': edge days (from/to) get accent fill + white text; in-range days get hover-row bg; hover previews the candidate range
Calendar syncs to anchorDate (date for single, from for range) whenever it changes — no manual calendar navigation reset needed
Width fixed at 380px; tab bar (single mode) is structural, reserved for future tabs like 'Bar number'

components.name: SortableTable
components.description: Generic sortable table primitive. Takes column defs (label, sortValue, render) + rows + gridCols template. Provides sticky clickable header with asc/desc arrow indicators, row striping (TABLE_ROW_STRIPE), row hover, and selection highlight (--color-warning). Currently used by BacktestTradesTable; designed so the live TradesTab can adopt it later.
notes: Column with no sortValue is rendered non-sortable (no pointer cursor, no hover)
sortedRows preserve originalIndex; getRowKey + selectedKey use stable IDs so selection survives re-sorts
Cell wrapper className defaults to 'px-2 text-center whitespace-nowrap' — override via column.cellClassName when needed (TradesTab uses 'px-3 text-center' historically)
Color/weight should live inside the rendered span, not the wrapper, because the wrapper class is static per column
maxHeight prop enables overflowY:auto only when set — list mode (no scroll) just omits it

When maxHeight is set, rows are virtualized: only rows in the visible window (+OVERSCAN=8) are mounted, with top/bottom spacer divs preserving scroll height. Row geometry constants ROW_HEIGHT=30 (h-7 inner + 1px outer borders) and HEADER_HEIGHT=33 (h-8 inner + 1px bottom border) MUST stay in sync with the row markup
Does NOT support row grouping/expansion — live TradesTab will need a row-override mechanism if it adopts this

components.name: EquityCurveChart
components.description: Lightweight-Charts BaselineSeries equity curve. Shared between Strategy Lab (live SSE point streaming) and the stats dashboard (StatsPnlChart equity mode + StatsDayDetail day-detail curve). Built-in crosshair tooltip shows Trade #N · time · value; optional per-trade markers via showMarkers.
notes: Pass points as EquityPoint[] ({ t: ISO string, equity: number }) + initialEquity; tooltip and Y axis display value as (equity - initialEquity)
Stats callers pass initialEquity=0 with stats.equityCurve[i] as the equity field (cumulative P&L is already delta-based)
background prop must be a resolved color (canvas fill) — use COLOR_TABLE_STRIPE for stats panel, default '#000000' for backtest panel
showMarkers + markerThreshold (default 80) — markers hide automatically for dense series to avoid clutter
Tooltip is rendered as a fixed centered overlay inside the chart; no parent-level hover state needed
background changes are baked into the chart on mount — changing it remounts the chart (background is in the mount effect's deps)

Streaming optimization: when new points are the previously-rendered array with extra tail items appended, the sync effect calls series.update() per new point instead of series.setData() with the full array — avoids O(N²) churn (StrategyLabModal also rAF-batches its SSE equity callback). Sanity check compares the last-rendered point's time + value against the input; mismatches fall back to a full setData().

components.name: ToolbarPillButton
components.description: Shared pill-shaped header button used across the Strategy Lab toolbar (Symbol picker, Date range, etc.). Consistent: bg --color-input, border --color-border, padding 5px 10px, hover:bg --color-border, rounded-md, text-xs. Children render free-form (icons + label + ChevronDown if needed).
notes: Different from DropdownButton (bg --color-surface, RADIUS.XL, border-color hover) — keep both
No built-in chevron — caller renders ChevronDown explicitly when needed for flexibility

components.name: VerticalSeparator
components.description: Shared draggable horizontal divider for vertical pane splits. 1px tall, cursor-row-resize, accent on drag. Optional collapse toggle button (chevron) appears on hover or when collapsed. Used by App.tsx (chart/bottom panel split) and StrategyLabModal (backtest chart/results split).
dependencies: ChevronDown / ChevronUp icons (only when onToggle is provided)
notes: onDrag receives mouseRatio = (e.clientY - containerTop) / containerHeight — caller decides whether to invert (1 - r) for bottom-anchored panels
containerRef points to the SHARED parent containing all split children — its bounding rect is captured on mousedown, not on every mousemove (avoids re-layout cost)
Toggle button is omitted when onToggle is not provided — pass both `collapsed` and `onToggle` to enable it; pass neither for a pure resizer

components.name: GoToModal
components.description: Modal that lets the user jump the chart to a specific date and time (NY timezone). Has a date text input, time text input, month calendar grid with today highlight, and Cancel/Go to footer buttons. Converts NY local time to UTC seconds for the chart API.
dependencies: CandlestickChart (renders GoToModal, calls chart.scrollToPosition on confirm)
GoToMarkerPrimitive (draws the temporary marker line after navigation)
notes: nyNow() and nyLocalToUtcSeconds() handle all timezone math — dates displayed and selected are always NY local
Tab bar (single 'Date' tab with accent underline) is structural, not decorative — reserved for a future 'Bar number' tab
Calendar width: 380px; selected day uses border-only style (no fill) to match GoToModal design

components.name: PositionsTab
components.description: Bottom-panel tab listing open positions with live unrealized P&L. Default view: current account + current chart symbol only. Filters (current/all account, current/all symbol) and Flatten-all action live in the header. Each row is clickable (switches account + chart contract); inline X flattens that position.
dependencies: useStore (positions, openOrders, accounts, activeAccountId, positionsAccountFilter, positionsInstrumentFilter, contract/secondContract, orderContract, lastPrice, pnlMode)
realtimeService (subscribeQuotes, onQuote — for live lastPrice per non-active contract)
tradeService + TradesTab.allTradesCache (history used to derive openTime + ptsTaken)
formatAccountName (shared from utils/formatters — same label as TopBar selector)
notes: Lazy fetch: when positionsAccountFilter switches to 'all', positionService.searchOpenPositions is called once per non-active account; trades are fetched with getDateRange('all') to match TradesTab's window — anything shorter (e.g. 'week') silently breaks ptsTaken/openTime for older positions

findOpenSegment walks trades chronologically, resetting the segment whenever net size returns to 0. Requires Math.abs(net) === currentSize at the end; otherwise openTime/ptsTaken render as '—' (intentional safeguard against cache/realtime lag)
TP legs are sorted by distance from entry (ascending for long, descending for short) so the displayed TP price is the *closest* one — prevents flicker when the gateway reorders the legs
openOrders is only the active account's orders — for positions on other accounts the TP/SL cells always render '—' (gateway doesn't expose other accounts' bracket legs)
Quote subscriptions are not torn down (matches useAccountUpnl) — the adapter's subscribe set is not ref-counted; unsubscribing here would kill the chart's stream when both reference the same contract
Tab count badge in BottomPanel.tsx reflects ACTIVE account positions only, not the current filter scope
Row click sets contract on the currently selectedChart (left → setContract, right → setSecondContract) AND setOrderContract, then setActiveAccountId if cross-account
Flatten all closes every row in sortedRows (potentially across accounts when filter='all') — no confirm dialog; button label shows count to make scope visible
PnL cell: only the inner value span is clickable + hover-highlighted (not the whole cell) — keeps row click (focus chart) distinct from PnL mode toggle ($/pts)
Account name under symbol (all-accounts filter) is rendered via formatAccountName + last 2 digits of id — e.g. 'Practice - 45'

components.name: StrategiesTab
components.description: Bottom-panel tab showing live strategy instances. Displays strategy name, status (with colored dot), signal direction, confidence, bar count, and start/stop action. Start opens a config modal (account, contractId, contractName, tickSize). SSE subscription keeps state live.
dependencies: useStore (liveStrategies, setLiveStrategies, updateLiveStrategy, baseUrl, accounts, activeAccountId, contract)
notes: liveStrategies is NOT persisted — it is live-only state reset on each mount via the SSE snapshot
serverUrl comes from useStore(s => s.baseUrl) — same base URL as the main backend
IS_DEMO guard skips both initial fetch and SSE subscription
Config modal uses shared/Modal as backdrop shell; panel styled inline (FRVP-style label+control rows, inline footer buttons)

components.name: shared/Modal
components.description: Modal shell: backdrop overlay + centered panel. Handles Escape-to-close and backdrop-click-to-close. Optional title prop renders a standard header with XIcon close button. Minimal mode (no title) leaves callers in full control of children.
notes: Props: onClose, children, className, style, backdropClassName, backdropStyle, title?, headerActions?, headerStyle?
title: pass a string or ReactNode — Modal renders flex header row with X button. Omit for raw-shell mode.
headerActions: ReactNode rendered between title and X (e.g. UnitToggle in BracketSettingsModal)
headerStyle: overrides default header padding (default '12px 16px 10px')
Backdrop click only closes when the click target IS the backdrop div

components.name: shared/Button
components.description: Shared button primitive. variant × tone × size matrix, plus toolbar and tab variants. Use instead of raw <button> for all action buttons.
notes: variant: 'ghost' | 'filled' | 'toolbar' | 'tab'
tone: 'default' | 'danger' (only applies to ghost/filled)
size: 'sm' (6px 12px) | 'md' (8px 16px). Font = var(--font-size-overlay)
toolbar: pill button — bg --color-input, border, hover bg --color-border, rounded-md, xs font
tab: transparent, text-muted → text on hover/active; active prop shows 2px bottom underline
fullWidth=true adds w-full; disabled=true → opacity-50 + cursor-not-allowed automatically
Replaced: ToolbarPillButton (→ variant='toolbar') and TabButton (→ variant='tab' active={bool})

components.name: shared/Checkbox
components.description: Custom-styled checkbox primitive. White fill + black checkmark SVG when checked. Renders a bare box when no label, or a click-anywhere label row when label is provided.
notes: Props: checked, onChange(checked), label?, disabled?, className?
Extracted from ChartSettingsModal local Checkbox — same visual: 16x16, border, white bg + black check
SettingsModal's native <input type='checkbox'> has been migrated to this component

components.name: shared/Toggle
components.description: On/off toggle switch primitive. Accent-colored track when on, --color-border when off. Renders a bare switch or a full label row (label on left, switch on right).
notes: Props: value, onChange(value), label?, disabled?, className?
Track: 32×18px, radius 9px. Thumb: 14×14px, transitions left 2px → 14px
With label: renders flex row justify-between (label left, switch right)
